title: Create GitHub repository
body:
**Goal**
Create the private `genesis-ai` repository.

**Why**
GitHub Milestones + Issues are the project source of truth.

**Done when**
- [ ] Repository exists under `NahuelGenchi`
- [ ] Main branch exists

title: Define mission and non-goals
body:
**Goal**
Lock the project mission and boundaries.

**Why**
Prevent scope drift.

**Done when**
- [ ] README states mission
- [ ] Independence and $0 rules are explicit

title: Enforce issue-first project tracking
body:
**Goal**
Make Milestones + Issues the source of truth.

**Why**
Every change must remain visible and understandable.

**Done when**
- [ ] Tracking rules documented
- [ ] Issue templates added
- [ ] No untracked-work rule documented

title: Create zero-budget guardrails
body:
**Goal**
Guarantee the project requires $0 spend.

**Why**
Budget is a hard constraint.

**Done when**
- [ ] Paid dependencies prohibited
- [ ] Free-resource policy documented

title: Create independent model baseline
body:
**Goal**
Implement a randomly initialized causal LM baseline.

**Why**
Validate training, checkpoint, eval, and generation end to end.

**Done when**
- [ ] Model builds
- [ ] Forward pass works
- [ ] Parameter count is reported

title: Add local smoke tests
body:
**Goal**
Catch basic regressions for free.

**Why**
The bootstrap must be reproducible.

**Done when**
- [ ] Unit tests pass locally
- [ ] No training data required

title: Add minimal CI
body:
**Goal**
Run lightweight checks on repository changes.

**Why**
Protect main without wasting compute.

**Done when**
- [ ] Tests run in CI
- [ ] Workflow stays lightweight
- [ ] No paid service required

title: Fix offline bootstrap validation
body:
**Goal**
Make local tests work without downloading build dependencies.

**Why**
The first validation failed because this workspace has no package-network access.

**Done when**
- [ ] Tests run via `PYTHONPATH=src`
- [ ] Failure is documented

title: Fix Issue template label mismatch
body:
**Goal**
Use canonical project labels in Bug and Decision templates.

**Why**
Templates referenced generic labels instead of `type:bug` and `type:decision`.

**Done when**
- [x] Bug template uses `type:bug`
- [x] Decision template uses `type:decision`
- [x] Tracking manifest records the defect

title: Automate Milestone and Issue bootstrap
body:
**Goal**
Create GitHub tracking from versioned manifests automatically.

**Why**
The connected GitHub tool cannot create Milestones.

**Done when**
- [ ] Bootstrap script is idempotent
- [ ] Workflow uses repository `GITHUB_TOKEN`
- [ ] No paid dependency

title: Fix connector-triggered bootstrap
body:
**Goal**
Investigate why connector-originated pushes initially appeared to create no Actions runs.

**Why**
The first API checks returned zero runs.

**Done when**
- [x] Confirm push events were received
- [x] Identify delayed run visibility
- [x] Remove temporary Issue-edit trigger

**Notes**
Runs appeared after API propagation. The real blocker is hosted-runner billing, tracked separately.

title: Register zero-cost self-hosted runner
body:
**Goal**
Connect one trusted local Linux x64 machine as the project runner.

**Why**
Milestone bootstrap and CI need a $0 execution path.

**Done when**
- [ ] Runner is online
- [ ] Tracking bootstrap passes
- [ ] CI passes

title: Replace billed GitHub-hosted runners
body:
**Goal**
Remove GitHub-hosted runners as a project dependency.

**Why**
GitHub refuses to start hosted jobs because of an account billing/spending restriction.

**Done when**
- [x] Root cause recorded
- [x] Workflows target self-hosted runners
- [x] Runner setup documented

title: Verify remote bootstrap
body:
**Goal**
Verify repository files, Milestones, Issues, and CI on GitHub.

**Why**
Local bootstrap is complete but remote creation still needs GitHub-side verification.

**Done when**
- [x] Files are on `main`
- [ ] 9 Milestones exist
- [ ] Bootstrap Issues exist with correct states
- [ ] CI passes

title: Define dataset provenance schema
body:
**Goal**
Describe every training source consistently.

**Why**
Data provenance is a core quality and legal requirement.

**Done when**
- [ ] Schema defined
- [ ] License/usage basis required
- [ ] Checksums supported

title: Build corpus ingestion CLI
body:
**Goal**
Ingest approved local/open corpora reproducibly.

**Why**
Manual data handling will not scale.

**Done when**
- [ ] CLI ingests manifests
- [ ] Outputs deterministic shards
- [ ] Invalid sources fail clearly

title: Build deduplication and quality filters
body:
**Goal**
Remove duplicates and low-quality material.

**Why**
Data quality is our strongest zero-budget lever.

**Done when**
- [ ] Exact dedup works
- [ ] Near-duplicate plan exists
- [ ] Filter metrics are reported

title: Train first project tokenizer
body:
**Goal**
Replace the byte bootstrap with a measured tokenizer.

**Why**
Token efficiency directly affects training and inference cost.

**Done when**
- [ ] Tokenizer trained only on approved data
- [ ] Compression measured
- [ ] Reversible encoding tested

title: Train first tiny model from scratch
body:
**Goal**
Complete the first real training run from random weights.

**Why**
Prove the full pipeline on minimal compute.

**Done when**
- [ ] Training loss decreases
- [ ] Checkpoint saved
- [ ] Run metadata recorded

title: Add resumable checkpoints
body:
**Goal**
Resume interrupted training exactly.

**Why**
Free compute is unreliable and must not be wasted.

**Done when**
- [ ] Model state restored
- [ ] Optimizer state restored
- [ ] Step restored

title: Add deterministic generation CLI
body:
**Goal**
Generate text from project checkpoints.

**Why**
Every checkpoint needs a simple reproducible interface.

**Done when**
- [ ] Prompt accepted
- [ ] Seed supported
- [ ] Temperature/top-k supported

title: Record baseline model card
body:
**Goal**
Document the first model's data, architecture, limits, and metrics.

**Why**
Every model generation needs an auditable record.

**Done when**
- [ ] Architecture recorded
- [ ] Training data recorded
- [ ] Metrics recorded
- [ ] Limitations recorded

title: Build versioned evaluation harness
body:
**Goal**
Compare every checkpoint with identical tests.

**Why**
Progress must be measured, not guessed.

**Done when**
- [ ] Eval definitions versioned
- [ ] Machine-readable results
- [ ] Incumbent/candidate comparison

title: Add compute and inference benchmarks
body:
**Goal**
Measure time, memory, throughput, and estimated $/M tokens.

**Why**
Efficiency is a first-class objective.

**Done when**
- [ ] Training throughput measured
- [ ] Decode throughput measured
- [ ] Peak memory measured
- [ ] Cost formula documented

title: Add contamination checks
body:
**Goal**
Keep evaluation holdouts out of training.

**Why**
Contaminated scores are useless.

**Done when**
- [ ] Exact overlap checked
- [ ] Results logged
- [ ] Blocking contamination fails eval

title: Create architecture experiment harness
body:
**Goal**
Compare architecture changes under equal compute budgets.

**Why**
Only measured improvements should scale.

**Done when**
- [ ] Fixed-budget experiments supported
- [ ] Results comparable
- [ ] Seeds recorded

title: Benchmark attention and context variants
body:
**Goal**
Find the best quality/compute context design.

**Why**
Attention cost dominates longer contexts.

**Done when**
- [ ] Baseline compared
- [ ] At least two alternatives tested
- [ ] Decision recorded

title: Prototype sparse MoE routing
body:
**Goal**
Test sparse expert computation at tiny scale.

**Why**
Sparse activation may improve capacity per active FLOP.

**Done when**
- [ ] Tiny MoE trains
- [ ] Routing metrics logged
- [ ] Dense baseline comparison

title: Benchmark low-bit inference
body:
**Goal**
Measure quantization quality and speed tradeoffs.

**Why**
Inference cost is a core target.

**Done when**
- [ ] Baseline measured
- [ ] Quantized variant measured
- [ ] Quality regression reported

title: Build challenger task generator
body:
**Goal**
Generate useful tasks near the model's current capability.

**Why**
Self-improvement needs a curriculum that evolves.

**Done when**
- [ ] Tasks generated without proprietary APIs
- [ ] Difficulty metadata recorded
- [ ] Duplicate control exists

title: Build deterministic verifier framework
body:
**Goal**
Score tasks without trusting the model's own opinion.

**Why**
Reliable feedback is required for safe self-improvement.

**Done when**
- [ ] Math/code/structured verifier interface
- [ ] Failures are explicit
- [ ] Scores reproducible

title: Build candidate experience pipeline
body:
**Goal**
Turn verified experience into candidate training data.

**Why**
Only high-signal examples should affect future weights.

**Done when**
- [ ] Provenance retained
- [ ] Quality thresholds configurable
- [ ] Rejected data auditable

title: Implement checkpoint promotion gate
body:
**Goal**
Promote N+1 only when it beats N under fixed gates.

**Why**
Prevent uncontrolled regressions.

**Done when**
- [ ] Required metrics defined
- [ ] Blocking regressions defined
- [ ] Promotion decision reproducible

title: Define model scaling ladder
body:
**Goal**
Scale through evidence-based parameter/compute stages.

**Why**
Large runs must earn their compute.

**Done when**
- [ ] Stage sizes defined
- [ ] Promotion criteria defined
- [ ] Zero-budget feasibility checked

title: Reach first useful-domain checkpoint
body:
**Goal**
Produce a model that is measurably useful in at least one domain.

**Why**
Useful capability is more meaningful than parameter count.

**Done when**
- [ ] Domain selected by eval evidence
- [ ] Baseline beaten
- [ ] Model card published

title: Create zero-cost local inference path
body:
**Goal**
Run released checkpoints locally with no paid service.

**Why**
The project must remain accessible at $0.

**Done when**
- [ ] One-command local inference
- [ ] Hardware requirements documented
- [ ] No network dependency

title: Create contribution workflow
body:
**Goal**
Make external experiments reproducible and reviewable.

**Why**
Community compute can accelerate a zero-budget project.

**Done when**
- [ ] Contribution guide
- [ ] Experiment result format
- [ ] Data/license rules enforced

title: Track frontier quality-per-dollar gap
body:
**Goal**
Measure the gap to frontier systems without depending on them at runtime.

**Why**
The long-term mission needs an objective target.

**Done when**
- [ ] Public benchmark references versioned
- [ ] Project score tracked
- [ ] Inference-cost gap tracked
